onboarding.title: New vehicle?
onboarding.description: Here's a suggested setup order - every section stays available regardless of what you've done, so pick this up in any order or skip it entirely.

motorsServos.heading: Motors & Servos
motorsServos.safetyWarning: Ensure control surfaces can move freely and are clear of obstructions before testing.
motorsServos.notLoaded: Servo outputs haven't been loaded yet.
motorsServos.noActiveChannels: No active servo outputs found (every channel reports Disabled).
motorsServos.otherVehicleComingSoon: Motor/servo setup for this vehicle type - coming in a future release.
motorsServos.frameNotLoaded: Frame class/type haven't been loaded yet.
motorsServos.rebootRequiredWarning: Changing Frame Class or Frame Type requires a reboot to take effect - it will not apply live.
motorsServos.diagramUnavailable: No verified motor diagram for this frame class/type combination - wiring must be confirmed against ArduPilot's own documentation.
motorsServos.motorSafetyWarning: Remove propellers before testing motors. Hold a motor's number to spin it briefly and confirm it's wired to the correct position.
motorsServos.reverseNote: Reverse takes effect on the motor's next arm or after a reboot, and only works with DShot ESCs - PWM/OneShot ESCs still need two motor wires physically swapped.

wizard.testAllPrompt: Spin each motor briefly to confirm it's wired to the correct position and spins the correct direction - do this for every motor before continuing.

wizard.notTestedThisSession: No motors were spin-tested this session.
wizard.identifyIntro: The app spins each motor output one at a time. Watch the propeller, then click the position on the diagram (or its button below) where you see it actually spinning.
wizard.identifySpinning: Output {{motor}} is spinning - click the position you see spinning
wizard.identifyMismatch: You clicked {{clicked}}, but output {{expected}} was the one spinning - check the wiring/frame for output {{expected}}.
wizard.identifyAllConfirmed: All motors confirmed in the expected position.

compassCal.heading: Compass Calibration
compassCal.description: Start calibration, then rotate the vehicle slowly through as many orientations as possible until each compass's coverage sphere fills in.
compassCal.saved: Calibration accepted - offsets saved to the vehicle.

status.badOrientation: Failed - bad orientation, try again slower
status.badRadius: Failed - bad field radius (check for magnetic interference)

accelCal.heading: Accelerometer Calibration
accelCal.description: "Calibrate Level" is a quick one-position trim - use it after remounting the flight controller. "Full Calibration" is the complete 6-position calibration, needed after a fresh install or if the vehicle drifts in flight.
accelCal.movePrompt: Place the vehicle in this position, then confirm:
accelCal.fullFailed: Calibration failed - try again, moving through each position more slowly.

rcCal.heading: RC Calibration
rcCal.description: Make sure the transmitter is on and the receiver is connected. Start calibration, then move every stick and switch through its full range, including full throttle travel.
rcCal.armedRejection: The vehicle is armed - disarm before calibrating.
rcCal.movePrompt: Move every stick and switch through its full range of motion, including full throttle travel.
rcCal.noSignal: No RC signal received yet - check the transmitter and receiver.

rcSetup.heading: RC Input Setup
rcSetup.notLoaded: RC input settings haven't been loaded yet.
rcSetup.assignIntro: Select a function on the left, then click the channel you want it assigned to on the right - like BetaFlight's receiver tab.
rcSetup.optionsUnavailable: Aux function list unavailable - couldn't reach ArduPilot's parameter docs.
rcSetup.clickToAssign: Click a channel below to assign it.
rcSetup.selectFunctionFirst: Select a function on the left first.
rcSetup.confirmDescription: This will write {{count}} parameter(s) to the vehicle.

escCal.heading: ESC Calibration
escCal.description: Sets ESC_CALIBRATION to Auto and reboots the flight controller - it will drive full throttle for a few seconds, then zero throttle, entirely on its own. Listen for the ESC confirmation tones.
escCal.safetyWarning: Remove all propellers before calibrating ESCs.
escCal.started: Calibration command sent - the vehicle is rebooting and will calibrate automatically.

logs.heading: Log Data
logs.description: Drop a .skylog or .bin file. One skylog can contain several boards - the tool figures out each flight's board on its own. Everything is computed locally.

help.summary: How to enable the full skylog (-extended_log flag)
help.intro: Without the -extended_log flag, Skyline only logs the raw {tlm:...} record, and the numbers can only be recovered from .bin. To get decoded telemetry:
steps: Right-click the Skyline LRS shortcut → Properties.
In the Target field, after the closing quote, add a space and -extended_log.
Save and launch Skyline through this shortcut - new logs will have full telemetry.

columns.approximateNote: Columns marked (≈) are approximate or estimated values (from the GPS track after rejecting suspicious points, or computed by integration) and may differ from the actual figures.

table.footerHint: Column 1 (blue) is the detected board. Gray rows are likely ground tests.

token.intro: This map needs a free Cesium ion access token for 3D terrain and imagery. Get one at
token.instructions: Sign up free, then open the "Access Tokens" tab and click "Create Token" (not "OAuth Applications", that's for something else). It's stored only in your browser (localStorage) and never sent anywhere but Cesium's own servers.
